results.description:
Come take a joyous journey with Joe Marler as he introduces you to every aspect of his life post-rugby and (almost) everything that's going on in his head. A hugely entertaining and funny romp of a book.

'absolutely brilliant' Chris Evans

Joe Marler’s brain works like no-one else’s. Goes to places others cannot go. Gets stuck in strange eddies, makes leaps from established human knowledge to strange new frontiers. Finds angles and tangents where others find only dry facts and dead ends.

That’s what makes Joe Marler vs the World so entertaining.

You thought you knew about the world. You realised you only understood a little about Joe, although you’d rather fallen in love with him after Celebrity Traitors. Now you’re about to have your head filled with fresh wonder at both – and, for the first time, truly look at the marvels and minutiae all around you as only Joe Marler does.

No boundaries. No preconceptions. A natural sense of fascination and fun. Not a great deal of formal education. A desire to know more.

It’s a tour that makes no sense until it does: from deep space to the deep blue seas, from the paranormal to evolution and AI. In partnership with Joe’s mate and podcast co-host Tom Fordyce, we take in love, sex and death and we deep-dive into swearing, modern art and the music of Adele.

And, because this is Joe, it’s not just high jinks and easy japes. It’s the harder stuff, too – the challenges, the mistakes, the misadventures, the lessons learned.

Occasionally messy. Quite often hysterical. Always endearing. This is Joe Marler exploring the world. Come along with him. And please bring some meat-based snacks.

Reviews

'absolutely brilliant' Chris Evans, Virgin Radio

About the author

Describing himself as looking like 'a melted wheelie bin', Joe Marler is a hugely popular retired rugby player who won 95 caps for England between 2012-2024. He won the Six Nations three times and reached the World Cup final in 2019.

He fronted a mental health documentary for Sky Sports in 2021, Big Boys Don't Cry, and presented an hilarious podcast called Joe Marler's Things People Do. His new podcast, Joe Marler Will See You Now, is also a smash hit.

He was the breakout star of the 2025 series of Celebrity Traitors.
